metadata.title: The Well-Tempered clAIvier
metadata.subtitle: Prelude IV in C-sharp minor - v2 (hand-authored, with development and drop)

notes: A1 i: U states M; L enters on beat 3, octave below
A2 i-V: L completes M; U in parallel thirds
A3 i-V: U states; L plays the motif rhythm in inversion
A5 i: L states (tenor), U sustains/echoes head rhythm
A6 iv: M up a fourth
A7 V: M on the dominant with leading tone
B9 I: M in E major; L answers one beat later
B14 V7-I7: D natural (7th of E7) anticipates A
C18 A7 respelled: German 6th (A C# E F##)
C19 V pedal; M in augmentation (1)
C22 DROP: M as continuous sixteenths over off-beat pulses
C24 hemiola begins: 3 x 8 sixteenths over 3/4
D27 i: canon at an eighth
D29 i: both lines in the motif rhythm, parallel tenths
D32 i: L leads, U canon at an eighth
D40 i: motif with rising tail
D44 tail G#-F#-E-D# (the link to the fugue) over i6-V6/5
